audit.whatIsWrong: full.diff reads FAV while diffRating reads 8/10 and breakdown.difficulty plus the Final Matchup Rating both say 'Hard matchup'. The content layer meanwhile states outright that the lane is favoured at 60.87%.
audit.why: Same page, opposite verdicts. A 60.87% win rate over 46 games is not an 8/10 difficulty, and a player reading the rating line will play the lane as a loss he is supposed to survive rather than a scaling lane he is supposed to win.
audit.corrected: diffRating 8/10 to 4/10, and both rating lines reworded to 'Favoured', matching diff=FAV and the content layer. Lucian's carry threat left at 8.5/10 — his early kill pressure genuinely is that high, which is what the 8/10 was really measuring.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] promised 'mobility at last' with no numbers, and every spike row leaned on 'his E' without saying when it is actually available.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, but Riot's own text adds that Lightslinger attacks reduce it — so the printed cooldown is a ceiling, not a schedule. Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s at 500 range. Neither number was on the page.
audit.corrected: Riftwalk's range and cooldown added at phases[4]; Relentless Pursuit's 16-to-14 range plus the Lightslinger reduction added to phases[3], the cooldown block, tradeGood, dosFull[0].d and Key Ability Interactions.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ardent Blaze is described as a slow in three places — 'Ardent Blaze slow into Relentless Pursuit E'. It is not a slow. It marks and reveals enemies and gives LUCIAN move speed for attacking marked targets.
audit.why: The advice built on top of it — that he slows you to reset spacing — has the direction of the movement backwards. He does not pin you down; he speeds himself up, which is a different problem with a different answer.
audit.corrected: Corrected in spikes[1].text, wants.foe[1] and whys[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The pages say Void Stone's 15% magic reduction does nothing here, but never say the same about Null Sphere's shield — which also only absorbs magic damage.
audit.why: Half the correct observation was made. Kassadin's two defensive layers are both magic-only and Lucian's damage is physical, so the lane is not merely 'unhelped' by the passive, it is unhelped by the entire defensive kit. That is why levels 1-5 have to be conceded rather than traded.
audit.corrected: Stated together in tldr, spikes[0].text, whys[0], early, tradeBad and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightslinger's second trigger is absent everywhere: when a nearby enemy champion is immobilized, Lucian's next two basic attacks deal bonus magic damage.
audit.why: That makes every enemy jungle gank on Kassadin a damage amplifier, not just a CC chain — the root or stun that catches him also arms Lucian. It is the single most common way this lane produces a level-4 death and it was not mentioned.
audit.corrected: Added to the Jungle Interaction block.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why says 'E only charges when spells fly'. Force Pulse has not been charge-gated since V12.23 — it is a 21/20/19/18/17s cooldown that ability casts within 1800 units shorten by one second each.
audit.why: Beyond being three years stale, the correct mechanic matters more in this lane than most: Lucian's damage comes overwhelmingly from Lightslinger basic attacks rather than casts, so almost nothing shortens Force Pulse here and Kassadin should plan around the full 21 seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.late told the player to 'Q-silence the counterplay'; tradeGood, dosFull and dontsFull all say 'repeat every six seconds' and 'his answer is loaded'.
audit.why: Null Sphere has no silence — Riot's text is damage, a channel interrupt, and a magic shield. And nothing in Kassadin's kit runs on a six-second loop: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s and Null Sphere is 9 down to 7.
audit.corrected: Silence replaced with the shield; the six-second claim replaced with Relentless Pursuit's actual timer, which is the cooldown that matters.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d called it 'the fifteen-second invitation' after a spent Relentless Pursuit.
audit.why: Fifteen seconds is the rank-3 base, but Lightslinger attacks shorten it — a Lucian farming a wave gets it back well inside fifteen. Counting seconds instead of watching his attacks is how Kassadins get caught mid-commit.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to count his autos rather than a stopwatch, in dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[1].d and Common Mistakes.

edits.before: Lucian is a genuine bully here and your whole kit is built to lose this part — Void Stone's 15% magic reduction blanks nothing because every point of his damage is AD. Lightslinger fires a guaranteed second shot off any ability, so the instant you step up to last-hit he hits Piercing Light Q and auto-doubles you. Do not throw Null Sphere as poke; you cannot win that trade and you will run yourself out of mana. Soak XP, take CS under tower, and accept that you are conceding these levels by design — the 60% win rate is earned after this, not during it.
edits.after: Lucian is a real bully here and your whole kit is built to lose this part — Void Stone reduces magic damage and Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic, and every point of his output is physical, so neither does anything. Lightslinger fires a guaranteed second shot off any ability, so the instant you step up to last-hit he hits Piercing Light and auto-doubles you. Do not throw Null Sphere as poke; you cannot win that trade and you will run yourself out of mana. Soak XP, take CS under tower at Q's 650, and accept that you concede these levels by design — the 60% win rate is earned after this, not during it.

edits.before: Keep weathering it through 4-5 — Nether Blade's quintupled mana restore off champion hits is what lets you farm under tower without going dry, and a maxed Null Sphere shield can eat one Q-W poke rotation when you have to walk up. At 6 the lane flips: Riftwalk gives you a blink to disengage his Relentless Pursuit E mid-trade and dodge The Culling, so you can finally punish him if he over-extends. Don't force it — just stop being free and ride your Q shield through his burst until your first stall item lands.
edits.after: Keep weathering it through 4-5 — Nether Blade restores mana on the hit, which is what lets you farm under tower without going dry, and a maxed Null Sphere shield can eat one poke rotation when you have to walk up. At 6 the lane flips: Riftwalk gives you a blink to leave Relentless Pursuit mid-trade and to dodge The Culling. Count his dash by his hands, not a stopwatch — Lightslinger attacks shave those fifteen seconds down while he farms. Don't force it; just stop being free until your first stall item lands.

edits.before: This is the entire reason the lane is favoured at 60.87%: Lucian is a lane-bully ADC stranded in top with no scaling, and you are one of the hardest scalers in the game. Once Nashor's or Lich Bane and a maxed Riftwalk come online, you blink in, chain R recasts for escalating burst, and he has a single Relentless Pursuit E to answer an opponent he cannot pin or kite. Force the side-lane 1v1, blink past his E, and delete him — he has no defensive dash beyond that one charge and no late-game.
edits.after: This is the entire reason the lane is favoured at 60.87%: Lucian is a lane-bully ADC stranded in top with no scaling, and you are one of the hardest scalers in the game. notes: BLOCKED BY THE LENGTH BAND: content win[] and full phases[] both hand Lucian levels 1-5 AND level 6 AND first item, with only 'Skill' at two items — on a lane the same page calls favoured at 60.87% over 46 games, and whose own prose says the lane flips at 6. phases[4].side and phases[5].side should read Skill and Kassadin, and win[6]/phases[6].side should read Kassadin. 'Lucian' to 'Skill' is 6 chars to 5 (in band, but the wrong direction alone would make the chart incoherent) and 'Skill' to 'Kassadin' is 5 to 8, which is +60% and gets rejected. The whole chart needs flipping together by hand. UNVERIFIED, REMOVED RATHER THAN RESTATED: (1) Void Stone's '15% magic reduction' appeared three times — Riot's description gives no number, so where I rewrote those strings I dropped the figure and kept the mechanic. (2) content.wants.you[0] and mid claimed Nether Blade gives a 'quintupled mana restore' off champion hits; Riot's text says only 'restores Mana', so I removed the multiplier. Both should go back if someone can source them. ALSO: the _missing-interactions.json entries for this matchup are unusable — 'Lucian sustains through chip damage (Lightslinger)' and 'Lucian can cancel your Null Sphere with Lightslinger' are both generated off flags that misread Riot's passive text (the heal clause is about Lucian BEING healed by an ally, and Null Sphere is not a channel — it interrupts them). Neither was written into any string. CHAMPION-WIDE, VERIFIED ON THE WIKI: Void Stone is 10% magic damage reduction, not the 15% written across these pages (reduced in V11.24) — the two strings are the same length, so the fix applies cleanly wherever '15%' appears. And phases[2].why's 'E only charges when spells fly' boilerplate is on every Kassadin matchup page and has been wrong since V12.23.
